blocks.text:
Breakfast at the hotel. The transfer to Ilha Grande has two legs, first by car and then by private boat. After you arrive, check in at your hotel and take some time to relax.

Ilha Grande is near Rio de Janeiro. The island is car-free, with plenty of beaches, tropical greenery and places to relax by the water. Taking a boat is one of the main ways to explore the coast.
